basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: First Class B.E / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering
post_wise_qualification.desirable: Experience in (a) calibration of instruments, (b) knowledge of CAD software like Creo / Solidworks / NX, (c) knowledge of measuring machines like CMM / ULM / VMS

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: First Class Diploma in Mechanical Engineering
post_wise_qualification.desirable: Experience in (a) calibration of instruments, (b) knowledge of CAD software like Creo / Solidworks / NX

selection_process: Candidates are selected through the walk-in interview. A written examination may also be held. CMTI may use its own method to shortlist candidates for the interview or written examination. It does not have to shortlist everyone who meets the minimum requirements. Having the required qualification does not guarantee an interview call. The conditions may be relaxed for highly deserving or exceptional candidates.
how_to_apply: Fill in the application in the prescribed format. Use one application per post, and include a valid email ID, which is compulsory.
SC/ST/OBC/EWS candidates must attach a photocopy of a valid caste certificate. OBC and EWS certificates must be in the Government of India format.
Go to CMTI, 1st Floor, Centre of Excellence, Plot No. G-105/A1, Almighty Gate Road, GIDC Lodhika, Kalawad Road, Metoda, Rajkot – 360021, Gujarat, on 18 November 2026.
Register your name with the application during the time slot for your post.
Attend the interview, and the written test if one is held.

Bring all original documents that support the details in your application, with a photocopy of each, for verification at the interview. You will be disqualified if you do not produce the originals or if your certificates show any discrepancy. No TA/DA is paid for attending, and canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. Any changes to this recruitment will be notified only on the CMTI website.

content_sections.heading: CMTI Project Associate-I and Project Assistant-II Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: The stipend is consolidated, and no other benefits are given with it. HRA is paid at 20% of the stipend. Staff get one day of leave for each completed month, and leave cannot be encashed. The number of posts is indicative and may go up or down depending on the institute's needs. content_sections.heading: CMTI Project Associate-I and Project Assistant-II Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The cut-off date for all purposes, including age, is 31 October 2026. Age relaxation is given as per Government of India orders and norms. Only Indian nationals can apply. First class means an aggregate of 60% marks across all semesters of the qualifying examination. If your university or institute awards CGPA or SGPA grades, convert them to a percentage using your university's or institute's formula. CMTI will consider the converted percentage. Only experience in the relevant field gained after the minimum qualification for the post counts, and it must be backed by valid documents. CMTI will consider the qualification and experience held as on 31 October 2026. See the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through the walk-in interview. A written examination may also be held. CMTI may use its own method to shortlist candidates for the interview or written examination. It does not have to shortlist everyone who meets the minimum requirements. Having the required qualification does not guarantee an interview call. The conditions may be relaxed for highly deserving or exceptional candidates.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Both posts are on contract. They are temporary and tenure-based, and CMTI is under no obligation to regularise them. Selected candidates have no right to be absorbed into a regular post at CMTI. CMTI may fill the advertised posts or leave them unfilled, without giving reasons. If any detail in the application or given at the interview is not backed by documents, or is found to be wrong at joining or later, the candidate can be terminated without notice.

Go to CMTI, 1st Floor, Centre of Excellence, Plot No. G-105/A1, Almighty Gate Road, GIDC Lodhika, Kalawad Road, Metoda, Rajkot – 360021, Gujarat, on 18 November 2026. Register your name with the application during the time slot for your post. Attend the interview, and the written test if one is held. Bring all original documents that support the details in your application, with a photocopy of each, for verification at the interview. You will be disqualified if you do not produce the originals or if your certificates show any discrepancy. No TA/DA is paid for attending, and canvassing in any form leads to disqualification. faq.question: Q1. When and where is the CMTI walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on 18 November 2026 (Wednesday) at CMTI, 1st Floor, Centre of Excellence, Plot No. G-105/A1, Almighty Gate Road, GIDC Lodhika, Kalawad Road, Metoda, Rajkot – 360021, Gujarat.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for each post?
faq.answer: Registration for Project Associate-I runs from 09:30 to 10:00 hrs. Registration for Project Assistant-II runs from 10:00 to 10:30 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. Can a diploma holder apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for Project Assistant-II, which needs a first-class Diploma in Mechanical Engineering. Project Associate-I needs a first-class B.E/B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.

faq.question: Q4. What counts as first class?
faq.answer: An aggregate of 60% marks across all semesters. If you have CGPA or SGPA grades, convert them to a percentage using your university's formula.

faq.question: Q5. How is HRA calculated?
faq.answer: HRA is 20% of the stipend. The stipend is consolidated, and no other benefits are paid with it.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age cut-off date?
faq.answer: Age, qualification and experience are all counted as on 31 October 2026. Age relaxation is given as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q7. Will the job become permanent?
faq.answer: No. The posts are temporary and tenure-based. CMTI has no obligation to regularise them, and selected candidates have no right to be absorbed into a regular post.

faq.question: Q8. How much leave do project staff get?
faq.answer: One day of leave for each completed month. Leave cannot be encashed.
